what_this_is: Clustering on land and access only, with the spending axis removed from the feature space, and a test of whether spending composition separates the resulting types.

money_free_rule.materiality_rule_source: half an interquartile range, inherited from the 0.5 bar in the pre-registered meaningfulness rule
money_free_rule.stated_when: The four original criteria - nameability, spending relevance, algorithm agreement and stability - were written into this script before any money-free number existed. The materiality criterion was added after seeing that tight bootstrap intervals separate differences too small to matter, so it is post-hoc in its timing; its value is not post-hoc in origin, being inherited from the 0.5 bar already pre-registered for naming. The distinction is recorded rather than hidden under a blanket claim of pre-registration.

land_naming_is_circular: Naming measures are the columns used to cluster, so a cluster separable by land is separable by the same information the partition was built from. The independent test is the spending one.
